headline: Can you name the 4 chambers of the heart?
stat_note: chambers: 2 atria on top, 2 ventricles below
body:
Right atrium: takes in oxygen-poor blood
Right ventricle: pumps it to the lungs
Left atrium: holds oxygen-rich blood
Left ventricle: pumps it to the body

headline: 8 external carotid branches in one sentence
stat_note: Some Anatomists Like Freaking Out Poor Medical Students
body:
Superior thyroid, Ascending pharyngeal, Lingual, Facial, Occipital, Posterior auricular, Maxillary, Superficial temporal.
The last 2 are the terminal branches.
source: Source: Kenhub, External Carotid Artery; Radiopaedia

headline: 100 billion neurons? Closer to 86 billion
body: A 2009 count found about 86 billion neurons and about 85 billion other cells. Only 19% of the neurons sit in the cerebral cortex.
source: Source: Azevedo et al., J Comp Neurol, 2009
